definitions.explanation: The act of dedicating or offering something to a deity, sacred purpose, or higher cause.

examples.english: We offer sake to the gods.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{奉献|ほうけん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This building was dedicated to peace.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{奉献|ほうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A dedication ceremony was held at the beginning of the festival.

notes:
{奉献|ほうけん} combines {奉|ほう} (to offer respectfully) and {献|けん} (to present, to dedicate). It is a formal word used in religious, ceremonial, or solemn contexts. In Shinto, it refers to making offerings to ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧; in Christianity, it refers to consecration or dedication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奉献|ほうけん}{式|しき} — dedication ceremony
- {奉献|ほうけん}⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧/{奉献|ほうけん}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ — offering; dedicated item
- {奉献|ほうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧ — prayer of dedication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奉納|ほうのう}→奉納：12200_hounou⟧ — offering to a shrine or temple (more commonly used in Shinto contexts)
- ⟦{献上|けんじょう}→献上：13528_kenjou⟧ — presenting to a person of high rank
- ⟦{捧|ささ}げる→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧ — to offer; to devote (a more general verb)
